description:
This is a low-risk short-term fix for
https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/128084, for the purposes of 2.4.1. The actual fix for that issue is more risky and we'll target 2.5.

needs_fixed_stride_order is silently incorrect with args that are mutable because it creates clones of those args, writes into them, and doesn't update the original args.

This PR makes it so that needs_fixed_stride_order doesn't apply to inputs that are being mutated.

This PR doesn't completely fix the problem, but it makes it less incorrect: most of the time the input already has the correct strides but inductor fails to recognize it, and in those cases writing directly to the input is fine.

Test Plan:
- new test

Pull Request resolved: https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/133452
Approved by: https://github.com/eellison

Fixes #ISSUE_NUMBER
